result.summary: Updates the "How to Upgrade" documentation to instruct users to copy both the `bin/` and `libexec/` directories when installing new releases. This ensures the multiprocess wrapper and its corresponding binaries are upgraded together.
result.problem: Users manually upgrading Bitcoin Core on Linux by copying only `bitcoind` or `bitcoin-qt` leave the multiprocess helper binaries in `libexec/` outdated, causing issues when using the `bitcoin` wrapper executable introduced in #31375.
evidence: PR description: "Since #31375, Linux installs ship a bitcoin wrapper in bin/ that dispatches to multiprocess binaries in libexec/. Copying only bitcoind/bitcoin-qt leaves those stale."
Resolves open issue #36431: 'doc: "How to Upgrade" release notes section is outdated since the `bitcoin` wrapper executable'
result.card: Updates the upgrade instructions to tell users to copy both bin/ and libexec/ when upgrading releases. Following the existing upgrade guidance leaves multiprocess wrapper binaries stale on Linux systems. The change addresses open issue #36431 following the addition of the multiprocess wrapper executable in #31375.

risk.why: A typo or mistake in documentation could mislead users during manual upgrades but cannot directly cause runtime or consensus issues.
